//: Project settings for the ZCC Log Explorer. This repo is a local, offline log analyzer with no path to a live Zscaler tenant, so the Zscaler MCP server is denied here. Denying rather than allow-listing is deliberate: an allowlist would have to enumerate the MCP servers a contributor may legitimately use, and this repository is public. Every other MCP server a contributor has configured keeps working, untouched.
//why: Analysis has to be reproducible from the uploaded bundle alone. A conclusion that quietly depended on live tenant state could not be reproduced by the next engineer reading the same logs. Reading a customer's tenant is also a far wider grant than reading the files they sent.
//layers: Two independent layers. deniedMcpServers blocks the server itself and merges from every settings source. permissions.deny blocks its tool calls, and deny rules accept globs in the tool-name position, so the patterns below also cover a registration under a name not listed above. Globs are case-sensitive, hence the case variants.
